<USER_REQUEST>
TETEP SAMA BRO COBA GINI AJA LU INPLEMENTASIKAN DARI HASIL ENGGINER YG GUA KIRIM DAN LU HAPUS FILE2 YG GA PENTING DI REPO GUA # 🔬 Reverse Engineering: PixelHD On-Device AI Upscale

> **Sumber:** Analisis smali dari `classes2_smali.zip` (APK decompile PixelHD)  
> **Package:** `com.zwh.picturewidget.video`  
> **Tanggal Analisis:** 28 Juli 2026  
> **Tools:** ApkTool / jadx decompile → Smali analysis

---

## 📌 Ringkasan Eksekutif

PixelHD mampu melakukan AI upscale **langsung di HP tanpa server** karena menggunakan:

- **NCNN** (Tencent's neural network inference framework) via native `.so` library
- **Real-ESRGAN** model yang disimpan di dalam APK (`assets/`)
- **GFPGAN** untuk face restoration (model di-download on-demand dari HuggingFace)
- **Kotlin Coroutines** untuk background processing tanpa block UI
- **Mutex** untuk sinkronisasi frame processing per video

---

## 🗂️ Struktur Folder Kunci

```
com/zwh/picturewidget/video/
├── superresolution/
│   ├── RealEsrganBridge.smali       ← Bridge Java → Native (upscale)
│   └── FaceRestoreBridge.smali      ← Bridge Java → Native (face restore)
├── VideoToGifPerformerActivity.smali ← Main upscale video/GIF flow
├── RemoveImageBgActivity.smali       ← Upscale + face restore untuk foto
├── RemoveGifBgActivity.smali         ← Upscale untuk GIF
└── MainActivity.smali                ← Preload model saat app launch
```

```
a8/
├── H0.smali    ← Coroutine yang load RealEsrganBridge (dipanggil dari MainActivity)
└── R1.smali    ← Coroutine yang load FaceRestoreBridge (dipanggil dari RemoveImageBgActivity)

i8/
├── c.smali     ← Download GFPGAN model dari HuggingFace
└── d.smali     ← Load semua model NCNN: blazeface, encoder, esrgan
```

---

## 🧠 Core Engine: Native Library

### Library Name
```
System.loadLibrary("realesrganappncnn")
→ librealesrganappncnn.so
```

Satu `.so` file ini handle **dua model sekaligus**:
- Real-ESRGAN (video/image upscaling)
- Face Restore / GFPGAN (face enhancement)

### Native Methods (JNI Interface)

#### RealEsrganBridge
```java
// Load model dari APK assets
native boolean loadModel(AssetManager assets);

// Proses satu frame/gambar
// Params: bitmap, scale factor (2x/4x), model name, use face restore?
native Bitmap processImage(Bitmap bitmap, int scale, String modelName, boolean useFaceRestore);
```

#### FaceRestoreBridge
```java
native boolean loadModel(AssetManager assets);

// Proses satu gambar, khusus face restoration
native Bitmap processImage(Bitmap bitmap, boolean enhance);

// Bebaskan memory native
native void release();
```

---

## 🔄 Flow Lengkap: Dari Launch ke Output

### 1. App Launch — Preload Model (MainActivity)
```
MainActivity onCreate
  └─→ Coroutine (a8/H0.smali) launch di background
      └─→ new RealEsrganBridge()
          └─→ loadModel(context.getAssets())
              └─→ [Native] Load .param & .bin dari assets/
              └─→ NCNN net init → Vulkan GPU pipeline ready
```

> **Kenapa cepat?** Model sudah loaded di background saat user masih di home screen. Pas user klik "Upscale", langsung proses tanpa delay.

### 2. User Trigger Upscale (Video/GIF)
```
VideoToGifPerformerActivity
  └─→ Coroutines (Dispatchers.IO) — background thread
      └─→ Loop per frame:
          1. Extract frame jadi Bitmap
          2. Mutex.lock()  ← cegah race condition
          3. createScaledBitmap(bitmap, targetW, targetH)  ← resize dulu jika perlu
          4. RealEsrganBridge.processImage(
               bitmap,        ← frame yang mau di-upscale
               scaleInt,      ← 2 atau 4 (2x / 4x)
               modelName,     ← nama model string
               useFaceRestore ← flag dari K0.b()
             )
          5. Mutex.unlock()
          6. Output Bitmap → rekonstruksi ke video
          7. Nanotime() tracking → performance log
```

### 3. User Trigger Photo Upscale
```
RemoveImageBgActivity
  └─→ RealEsrganBridge.processImage()  ← upscale foto
  └─→ FaceRestoreBridge.processImage()  ← face enhance
  └─→ FaceRestoreBridge.release()        ← cleanup memory
```

---

## 📦 Model Files di APK Assets

Dari string yang ditemukan di `i8/d.smali`:

| File | Fungsi |
|------|--------|
| `yolov5-blazeface.param` | Face detection (NCNN) |
| `yolov5-blazeface.bin` | Face detection weights |
| `encoder.param` | Image encoder |
| `encoder.bin` | Encoder weights |
| `style.bin` | Style transfer weights |
| `real_esrgan.param` | Real-ESRGAN architecture |
| `real_esrgan.bin` | Real-ESRGAN weights |

### GFPGAN (Face Restore) — Download On-Demand
```
folder: face_restore_models/
file:   gfpgan_models_tmp.zip
url:    https://huggingface.co/ZZZHHHHW/mobilefaceswap/resolve/main/GFPGAN-ncnn-models.zip
```

> GFPGAN **tidak dibundle** dalam APK (terlalu besar). Di-download pertama kali user pakai fitur face restore, lalu di-cache di storage lokal (`i8/c.smali`).

---

## ⚡ Kenapa Bisa Cepat Tanpa Server?

| Faktor | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| **NCNN Framework** | Dioptimasi khusus mobile ARM, support Vulkan GPU acceleration |
| **Model Preload** | `loadModel()` dipanggil waktu `MainActivity` launch, bukan saat proses |
| **Mutex Singletons** | 1 instance `RealEsrganBridge` per Activity, tidak re-init tiap frame |
| **Dispatchers.IO** | Processing di IO thread pool, UI tidak freeze |
| **Assets Bundled** | Model `.param` + `.bin` ada di dalam APK, no network needed |
| **Frame-level Processing** | Tiap frame diproses independent, bisa progress reporting per frame |

---

## 🔒 Threading & Concurrency

```kotlin
// Pseudo-code rekonstruksi dari smali

class VideoToGifPerformerActivity {
    val esrganBridge = RealEsrganBridge()  // init di constructor
    val mutex = Mutex()                     // satu mutex per activity
    val scope = CoroutineScope(Dispatchers.Main)

    fun processFrames(frames: List<Bitmap>, scale: Int, model: String) {
        scope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
            frames.forEach { frame ->
                mutex.lock()
                try {
                    val result = esrganBridge.processImage(frame, scale, model, false)
                    // update UI via Main dispatcher
                } finally {
                    mutex.unlock()
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

---

## 🎯 Temuan Penting untuk Implementasi Kythera Tools

### ✅ Yang Bisa Langsung Diadopsi

1. **Preload model di Application/MainActivity level**  
   Jangan load model di VideoEnhanceScreen — user experience jauh lebih smooth.

2. **Single instance bridge + Mutex pattern**  
   Satu `RealEsrganBridge` per lifecycle, dilindungi Mutex buat concurrent access.

3. **processImage signature yang fleksibel**  
   Parameter `modelName: String` memungkinkan switch model tanpa re-init engine.

4. **GFPGAN download on-demand**  
   Bundled model untuk upscale (kecil), download untuk face restore (besar). APK size stays small.

### ⚠️ Perbedaan dengan Kythera Tools

| Aspek | PixelHD | Kythera Tools (Target) |
|-------|---------|------------------------|
| Model bundled | `real_esrgan.param/.bin` | `realesr-animevideov3` |
| Face detection | YOLOv5-BlazeFace | TBD |
| Face restore | GFPGAN (download) | GFPGAN atau CodeFormer |
| Processing unit | Vulkan GPU | Vulkan GPU (via NCNN) |
| Threading | Kotlin Coroutines + Mutex | Kotlin Coroutines + WorkManager |
| Queue | Per-Activity loop | Global background queue |

---

## 📋 File Smali Penting untuk Referensi Lebih Lanjut

| File | Isi |
|------|-----|
| `a8/H0.smali` | Coroutine load Real-ESRGAN model → baca ini untuk timing preload |
| `a8/R1.smali` | Coroutine load Face Restore → pattern identik |
| `a8/P1.smali` | Invocation `processImage` dengan parameter penuh |
| `i8/c.smali` | Logic download GFPGAN dari HuggingFace → reuse untuk model download manager |
| `i8/d.smali` | Init semua model NCNN sekaligus → list nama file assets |
| `VideoToGifPerformerActivity.smali` | Full upscale loop per frame + Mutex pattern |

---

## 🏁 Kesimpulan

PixelHD **bukan magic** — mereka cuma implement stack yang sudah proven:

```
Real-ESRGAN model → dikompres ke NCNN format → run via Vulkan GPU
```

Yang membuat terasa "cepat":
- Model preloaded sebelum user butuhkan
- GPU inference (bukan CPU)
- Frame processing async dengan progress callback
- Mutex cegah overhead dari concurrent calls

**Semua ini bisa direproduksi di Kythera Tools** karena kita sudah punya JNI/NDK setup, CMake pipeline, dan NCNN dependency dari native project skeleton yang sudah dibuat.

---
